name: Post-Settlement Settlements
scenario: Following the execution of an exhaustive supply chain vendor agreement, both parties recognize that execution exhaustion caused them to leave potential joint efficiencies unaddressed.
script: "We now have a fully executed, binding contract that guarantees both organizations' baselines. With that security established, are you open to an informal review: if we can identify an operational adjustment that benefits both parties without harming either, we implement it; if not, the executed agreement stands unconditionally."
defense: Defend the signed contract: do not reopen core terms under the rubric of post-settlement optimization.
originFull: Joint Gain Discovery Protocols demonstrate that negotiators, having secured a binding deal, operate in a state of psychological safety that dramatically lowers defensiveness, allowing them to uncover residual Pareto efficiencies.
defenseFull: When a counterparty attempts to exploit a post-settlement exploration to renegotiate concessions, defend the signed baseline: "The executed contract represents our finalized institutional boundary. We will not reopen core commercial terms under the rubric of post-settlement optimization."
